high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a tweet from the Twitter account @Dmj_dev, dated February 11, 2021. The tweet discusses two different secure phones: one made by Sirin Labs and the other, the Blackphone 2. Content: The top tweet mentions a phone made by Israel-based Sirin Labs with the help of Leonardo DiCaprio. It claims that the phone offers "the most advanced privacy technology, currently unavailable outside the agency world." The phone runs on a Snapdragon 810 processor and provides 256-bit AES encryption.
